english.note: Use this for one individual counted vote or ballot, especially when stressing how many votes someone has cast.
Use this when “voice” means an actual vote or ballot in a decision.

examples.english: I cast one vote for him this time.
examples.traditional: 我今次投咗一票支持佢。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 ci3 tau4 zo2 jat1 piu3 zi1 ci4 keoi5

examples.english: This time, I’m casting my voice for him.
examples.jyutping: gam1 ci3 ngo5 zoeng1 piu3 tau4 bei2 keoi5
